text:
ajay: quick idea: allow a tiny preface 'priming' frame immediately after TLS (before HTTP/2 preface) with client-id, session-id, model, warmup-hash, idempotency-token to start warmups and attach resume info.

maria: how's this different from resume-token header?

ajay: resume header is post-handshake. priming avoids an RTT so warmups start sooner.

kevin: risk: some proxies expect immediate HTTP/2 preface and may drop preface bytes. any frontdoor tests?

ajay: lab tests pass on our frontdoor but gRPC-web proxies can choke. plan: gate via ALPN token ('ri-priming/1') or DNS discovery flag; fallback to resume header when ALPN absent.

sophia: billing: priming may trigger prep work. do we bill?

ajay: proposal: priming free; billing starts when a request binds to backend. priming reserves minimal state; enforce soft quotas and show in console.

maria: need lease window for resume to avoid state growth. recommend ephemeral lease + LRU eviction.

kevin: implement priming lease in edge memory default 30s, adjustable per-tenant up to 5m for Dedicated. emit metric edge.priming.leases_evicted.

ops-bot: checklist: add ALPN gating, server feature-flag priming-optin, priming lease metrics, tests for gRPC-web.

sophia: side-effects: require action-id or idempotent flag for requests that use resume to prevent duplicate external effects; disable priming for high-safety routes by default.

ajay: encoding: prototype uses small binary envelope: 1-byte version, varint length, JSON payload, e.g. `0x01 <len> {"client":"mobile-1","sid":"...","token":"..."}`. will document fallback and tracing spans. RFC incoming tomorrow.

ops-bot: noted — added tasks to release checklist.
__notes: Thread about pre-handshake priming frame: ALPN gating, lease semantics, billing, idempotency and observability. Single-string Slack thread as required.
